slots.node01.text: Northfield's RFP asks for one partner to redesign how patients are scheduled, registered and billed, and to carry the change through to measurable cash and experience results.
slots.node03.body: A single scheduling and registration experience across all seven hospitals and 64 clinics.
slots.node05.body: Common front-end, claims and denial processes that cut days in A/R and rework.
slots.node07.body: A partner accountable from design through adoption, not only for delivery.
slots.node10.text: “We want a partner who owns the outcome, not the work plan.”
slots.source.text: Sample RFP language for layout only; replace with the client's RFP text before use.
